SummonerExhaust.name: Exhaust
SummonerExhaust.description: Exhausts target enemy champion, reducing their Movement Speed and damage dealt by 30% for 2.5 seconds and reduces their Attack Speed by 50% for the duration.
SummonerExhaust.tooltip: Exhausts target enemy champion, reducing their Movement Speed and Damage dealt by {{ f2 }}% for 2.5 seconds and reducing their Attack Speed by {{ f3 }}% for the duration.

SummonerFlash.name: Flash
SummonerFlash.description: Teleports your champion a short distance toward your cursor's location.
SummonerFlash.tooltip: Teleports your champion a short distance toward your cursor's location.

SummonerHeal.name: Heal
SummonerHeal.description: Restores 90-345 Health (depending on champion level) to your champion and to nearby allies.
SummonerHeal.tooltip: Restores {{ f1 }} Health to your champion and nearby allies.
